name: continue-budget
title: Continue budget
description: continue_budget requests native Agent approval with a nonblank reason up to 2000 characters; resumeAfterBudgetStop continues a run core stopped with BUDGET_EXCEEDED (consent, raise host budget, cancel, fresh send). No item tables. Consent alone changes no budget.
docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Register createContinueBudgetTool() on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution, and call resumeAfterBudgetStop from a host action with your own budget policy update. Requires the host's existing agevex package. Approvals use core respond, never native approveToolCall directly. See /docs/tools/continue-budget.
